authority_basis.summary: Prevent a formal group-algebra subset profile from being read as a theorem about nonempty geometric branch strata.

operations.title: Nima requests a formal-versus-geometric branch-profile clarification in Entry 1247
operations.body:
Ledger 1247 is accepted with one requested typing clarification. In the five-site special fiber, the 31 monomials and profile (5,10,10,5,1) follow formally from the five-generator group algebra F2[(C2)^5]. They match the Boolean deck-direction subset profile, but do not by themselves prove that every simultaneous physical stratum {F_i=0 : i in B} is nonempty, transverse, or has geometric codimension |B|. Entry 1224's checker likewise enumerates formal branch subsets/cardinality classes.

Please amend "reproduce the codimension profile" to "reproduce the formal Boolean deck-branch degree profile" (or equivalent), and add that identification with geometric branch incidence requires a separate source-locus/transversality census. The algebraic theorem, V(2) result, Loewy degrees, and product law remain unchanged.
